_comment: SET INDICES source of truth. Written at inception by the build session (Aug 24 2026); appended weekly by the Monday trend-scan STEP 3.6 re-mark. SCHEMA per index: base (always 100.00), inception, divisor (current), divisorLog[{date, before, after, why}], universe[{num, name, rarity}] (ALL slots in scope, priced or not), basket[{num, name, rarity, price, basis, asOf}] (only cards with sourced SOLD reads), history[{date, level, basketValue, divisor, priced, note}]. MATH: level = sum(basket prices) / divisor. INCLUSION (a universe card gets its first sourced sold comp): newDivisor = oldDivisor * (basketValueAfter / basketValueBefore) -- the level MUST be identical before and after; log it in divisorLog. RULES: sold comps only, dated + attributed, never asks, never estimated; base/inception/history rows are immutable; an index is a measurement, not a call. ADDENDUM Aug 24: universeComplete=false means the secret-tier enumeration is partial (API down at build) — STEP 3.6 must complete the universe list from pokemontcg.io before or during the next re-mark. ACTIVATION RULE: a pre-activation index (status=pre-activation, divisor null) activates when the weekly re-mark sources its first point sold reads — set divisor = basketValue/100 on that date, set inception, write history row level 100.00, flip status to live. DR25 also needs its universe enumerated (sv10 was down at build). MOVERS ADDENDUM (Aug 31 2026): basket entries carry prevPrice/prevAsOf = the prior weekly mark, so /indices renders card-level movers client-side; STEP 3.6 must roll these forward each re-mark (prevPrice <- old price) before writing new marks. New inclusions have no prevPrice until their second mark. REBASE ADDENDUM (Sep 30 2026, Mo in chat: 'rebase it' — every Pokémon index is based at its RELEASE date, not our inception). Pokémon tickers carry releaseDate, baseDate (YYYY-MM), baseRule ('release' = the release month or the first month of sold data after it; 'first-reliable' = the set predates PriceCharting's history, so 100 = the first month its ungraded history covers >= 90% of the basket by value), baseNote (the sentence pages print), recon[{month, level}] (monthly, RECONSTRUCTED from PriceCharting item-page chart_data 'used' = ungraded, current basket and weights, chain-linked on cards priced in both months; never a live mark, always drawn dashed and labelled), and rebase{date, factor, ruling, inceptionLevel}. The one-time rebase multiplied every history level by factor and divided every divisor by it (logged in divisorLog), so shape and every % move are unchanged; 'history rows are immutable' holds from here on. Live marks continue to append to history exactly as before (level = sum / divisor). Bowman tickers (BOW26, BB26, BCB26, BF26) are NOT rebased: 100 at inception.
